summary: Selects animation or blend-shape CHOP channels from an FBX or USD import parent, including playback, sample-rate, trim, cue, and extend controls for imported takes.
key_concepts: Reads channels from an FBX or USD import parent; an empty Parent searches the first import parent in the node path.
Take Type selects between imported animation playback and blend-shape playback.
Use Parent Animation lets the parent COMP drive playback, while local playback controls are used when it is off.
Play Mode supports timeline-locked playback, specified index random access, sequential playback, and full-range output.
Trim, Cue, Index, and Extend controls define the animation range, random access/cue points, and behavior outside the trimmed range.

key_params.name: parent
key_params.note: FBX or USD import parent COMP to read from

key_params.name: taketype
key_params.note: Select imported animation or blend-shape playback

key_params.name: shiftanimationstart
key_params.note: Shift the animation to the start indicated by the importing file

key_params.name: sampleratemode
key_params.note: Use file sample rate or custom rate

key_params.name: indexunit
key_params.note: Index units: frames, seconds, fraction, or index

key_params.name: trim
key_params.note: Enable Trim Start and Trim End

key_params.name: cue
key_params.note: Jump to Cue Point and stay there

key_params.name: cuepulse
key_params.note: Jump to Cue Point and continue playback

common_gotchas: Leaving Parent empty searches the first import parent in the path, which can surprise generated component templates.
Use Reload after replacing source assets or changing import settings.
Parent animation settings can override local playback controls when enabled.
Locked to Timeline disables local Play, Speed, Index, Cue, and Cue Point controls.
Sequential playback enables Play, Speed, Cue, and Cue Point controls, while Specify Index is for random access.
Trim and Cue units can be frames, seconds, fraction, or index; generated plans should state the chosen unit.
